The little boy George really likes to eat chocolate. He receives birthday pocket money from his grandparents and plans to go to the convenience store to buy a big chocolate. As he walks through the park, he sees a playground facility, where the staff tells him: "If you are willing to use your pocket money to participate in the game, you may win a super toy." George decides to try his luck and uses his pocket money to participate in the game.

[Question]
What does George do after he finishes the game?

[Candidate Answers]
A. George goes to the convenience store to buy chocolate.
B. George goes home and then shares his super toy with his family.
C. George does not go to the convenience store to buy chocolate.
D. George participates in the playground game again.
